route_trace.method: manual centreline sampling of organizer black course line in public raster rendering
route_trace.reproducibility_note: The 62 image-space vertices used for the 5.002 km measurement were not persisted. Repeat digitization or use a persisted OSM way sequence before producing a route asset.

interpretation: Strong validation that the georeferenced organizer raster represents an approximately 5 km loop. Not canonical GPX; refine by snapping to Lantmateriet Topografi 10 road/path geometry and validate against participant GPS.
promotion_rule: Do not label organizer GPX or race-day GPS. Provenance remains derived_from_georeferenced_organizer_map until independent participant GPS validation.

wgs84_retrieval_bbox_derived.purpose: OpenStreetMap retrieval envelope derived from approximate SWEREF raster controls; not route geometry.
